camel_example: aliyun alidns OperateBatchDomain --region cn-hangzhou --Type RR_ADD --DomainRecordInfo.1.NewType AAAA --DomainRecordInfo.1.NewValue '114.92.XX.XX' --DomainRecordInfo.1.Line default --DomainRecordInfo.1.Priority 5 --DomainRecordInfo.1.Value fd87da3c4528844d45af39200155a905 --DomainRecordInfo.1.NewRr mail --DomainRecordInfo.1.Ttl 600 --DomainRecordInfo.1.Rr zhaohui --DomainRecordInfo.1.Domain 'example.com' --DomainRecordInfo.1.Type MX
description_en: Adds or deletes domain names and DNS records in batches
description_zh: 进行批量操作以添加或删除域名和解析记录
kebab_example: aliyun alidns operate-batch-domain --type RR_ADD --domain-record-info Line=default Rr=zhaohui Type=MX Priority=5 Value=fd87da3c4528844d45af39200155a905 NewRr=mail NewValue=114.92.XX.XX Domain=example.com Ttl=600 NewType=AAAA --region cn-hangzhou
name: OperateBatchDomain

parameters.help_en:
The response language. Valid values:

zh: Chinese

en: English

Default value: zh
parameters.help_zh:
返回值语言，取值：
zh：中文
en：英文

默认：zh
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The batch operation type. Valid values:

DOMAIN_ADD: adds domain names in batches.

DOMAIN_DEL: deletes domain names in batches.

RR_ADD: adds DNS records in batches.

RR_DEL: deletes DNS records in batches. This operation deletes DNS records that match the conditions specified by `Rr`, `Value`, or both. If you do not specify `Rr` and `Value`, all DNS records for the specified domain name are deleted
parameters.help_zh:
批量操作类型，取值：

DOMAIN_ADD：批量添加域名
DOMAIN_DEL：批量删除域名
RR_ADD：批量添加解析
RR_DEL：批量删除解析（删除满足N.RR、N.VALUE、N.RR&N.VALUE条件的解析记录。如果无N.RR&&N.VALUE则清空参数DomainRecordInfo.N.Domain下的解析记录）
parameters.name: type

fields.help_en:
The domain name.

A single request can contain up to 200 entries. Exceeding this limit may cause the request to fail due to the HTTP request header size limit
fields.help_zh:
域名名称。

用户提交的数据， N 从 1 开始，最多 200 条数据。由于HTTP请求头限制，请勿超过 200 条数据
fields.name: domain

fields.help_en: The resolution line. Default value: default
fields.name: line

fields.help_en: The new host record. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only
fields.help_zh: 新的主机记录（仅修改操作时使用，外部用户不支持）
fields.name: new_rr

fields.help_en: The new record type. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only
fields.help_zh: 新的记录类型代码（仅修改操作时使用，外部用户不支持）
fields.name: new_type

fields.help_en: The new record value. This parameter is used only for modification operations and is for internal use only
fields.help_zh: 新的记录值（仅修改操作时使用，外部用户不支持）
fields.name: new_value

fields.help_en:
The MX priority.

This parameter is required if the record type is MX. Default value: 10
fields.help_zh:
MX优先级。

记录类型为MX时必需。默认：10
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en:
The host record.

This parameter is required when `Type` is RR_ADD or RR_DEL
fields.help_zh:
主机记录。

批量操作类型为RR_ADD、RR_DEL时必需
fields.name: rr

fields.help_en: The TTL, in seconds. Default value: *600*
fields.name: ttl

fields.help_en:
The record type. Examples: A, AAAA, TXT, MX, and CNAME.

This parameter is required when `Type` is RR_ADD or RR_DEL
fields.help_zh:
记录类型。例如：A、AAAA、TXT、MX、CNAME等。

批量操作类型为RR_ADD、RR_DEL时必需
fields.name: type

fields.help_en:
The record value.

This parameter is required when `Type` is RR_ADD or RR_DEL
fields.help_zh:
记录值。

批量操作类型为RR_ADD、RR_DEL时必需
